output.title: Does this Medicare Advantage plan include a dental allowance?
output.draft_text:
When a member asks whether their Medicare Advantage (MA) plan includes a dental allowance, open today's plan record and check the supplemental benefits section [confirm exact location of dental benefit in the plan record]. Keep the answer short.

If the plan record shows a dental allowance:
"Yes, your plan includes a dental allowance of [allowance amount] per [benefit period, e.g., calendar year / plan year / quarter]. It can be used for [covered dental services, e.g., preventive / comprehensive]. To use it, [how the allowance is accessed, e.g., prepaid card / provider bills plan / member submits for reimbursement]. [In-network requirement, if any, e.g., You need to see a dentist in the [dental network name] network.]"

If the plan record shows no dental allowance:
"I don't see a dental allowance on your plan record today. [Approved next step or referral, e.g., standalone dental plan options or the plan's member services number]."

If the record is unclear or the member asks how much is left:
[Approved process for checking remaining allowance balance or escalating unclear dental benefits].

Unused allowance: [whether unused allowance rolls over or expires at the end of the benefit period].

Before quoting any dollar amount for a dental service, [confirm whether a Legal verbatim disclaimer is required for dental estimates; the existing cost estimate disclaimer U-BEN-COST-001-02 covers in-network medical visits only].
placeholders: [confirm exact location of dental benefit in the plan record]
[benefit period, e.g., calendar year / plan year / quarter]
[how the allowance is accessed, e.g., prepaid card / provider bills plan / member submits for reimbursement]
[Approved next step or referral, e.g., standalone dental plan options or the plan's member services number]
[Approved process for checking remaining allowance balance or escalating unclear dental benefits]
[whether unused allowance rolls over or expires at the end of the benefit period]
[confirm whether a Legal verbatim disclaimer is required for dental estimates]
author_checklist: Confirm where advocates find the dental allowance on the plan record, and that it is plan-specific rather than standard across MA plans.
Confirm the allowance amount, or that it varies by plan and must be read from the record.
Confirm the benefit period and whether unused amounts roll over or expire.
Confirm which dental services the allowance covers and any exclusions.
Confirm how members access the allowance (card, direct billing, reimbursement) and any network requirements.
Confirm whether advocates can see a remaining allowance balance, and the escalation path if not.
Confirm with Legal whether a verbatim disclaimer is needed before quoting dental dollar amounts, since U-BEN-COST-001-02 applies only to in-network medical visits.
Confirm the approved next step for members whose plan has no dental allowance.
Align the tone and opening with U-BEN-COST-001-01 (short answer from today's plan record).
